title: Farbgewichtung / palette roles
slide_intent: Preserve a hierarchy between grounds and accents so identity remains visible without overwhelming content.
strategic_value: A neutral foundation can keep DB Red recognizable while letting Lilac provide selective expression.
demonstration: Three paragraphs assign roles to White/Cold Black, DB Red and Lilac above an unnumbered proportion graphic.
practical_value: Favor White as the base and use the accent colors according to their roles without inventing a percentage.

content_islands.name: Role explanation
content_islands.spec: Explain backgrounds first, identity accent second and expressive accent third.

content_islands.name: Weighting graphic
content_islands.spec: Place the unnumbered neutral/red/Lilac strip beneath the role descriptions.

reference_purposes.Application: The text assigns grounds to neutrals, identity accents to DB Red and selected expressive uses to Lilac.
reference_purposes.Constraint: White is the preferred ground; the graphic supplies no numeric area requirement.

ingredient.name: Palette weighting
ingredient.role: Keep neutral support, identity and expression distinguishable.
ingredient.application: Prefer White for the base; balance light/dark grounds and use DB Red and Lilac as their stated accents.
ingredient.scope: The displayed strip is qualitative. It does not prescribe fixed percentages per composition.
